1 Chronicles 1:34.bridge: The books of Chronicles now retell Israel's history from the beginning, opening with nine chapters of genealogies running from Adam through the tribes of Israel.

1 Chronicles 7:22.bridge: Some of the sons of Ephraim are killed while raiding the cattle of the men of Gath.

1 Chronicles 10:13.bridge: The narrative resumes with Saul's last battle: defeated by the Philistines on Mount Gilboa, he falls on his own sword, and three of his sons die with him.

1 Chronicles 13:9.bridge: David and all Israel set out to bring the ark of God to Jerusalem from Kirjath-jearim, carrying it on a new cart driven by Uzza and Ahio.

1 Chronicles 20:1.bridge: Ammon hires Syrian chariots and armies against David, but Joab and his brother Abishai rout them, and the Syrians make peace with David.

1 Chronicles 21:13.bridge: Over Joab's protest the census is taken. God is displeased, and the prophet Gad offers David a choice: three years of famine, three months of defeat, or three days of plague.

1 Chronicles 21:24.bridge: The angel tells Gad to have David build an altar on Ornan's threshing floor. Ornan offers David the site, the oxen, and the wood as a gift.

2 Chronicles 1:7.bridge: Solomon leads the assembly to the old tabernacle at Gibeon and offers a thousand burnt offerings there.

__tail__.bridge: God grants Solomon wisdom and knowledge and promises him riches and honour beyond any king before or after him.
